tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Executes an authenticated (or anonymous) Perplexity web search for the given workspace, creates a query record, persists the raw request/response payloads (when provided or generated), stores up to `limit` normalized results, and returns the created query plus the normalized results; this endpoint is not a general listing endpoint, but if the upstream supports incremental retrieval you may pass `cursor` to fetch the next page of results for the same invocation. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `workspace_id`/`api_key_id` do not match the required patterns, `limit` is outside 1–50, `provider`/`status` are not in the allowed enums, `query` is empty, or unknown fields are supplied. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the `api_key_id` is missing/invalid for a non-anonymous request, FORBIDDEN if the key is not permitted to bill against the specified `workspace_id`, NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace or API key does not exist, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when workspace/key quotas are exceeded, and CONFLICT if a client-supplied `status` attempts an invalid initial state for a newly created query record (e.g., `succeeded` without a stored response).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that will own and bill this search request (pplx_ws_01H...).

api_key_id.description: API key id used for the request; omit for anonymous/session-based searches (pplx_key_01H...).

query.description: The raw search query text to send to the Perplexity provider.

limit.description: Maximum number of normalized search results to return/store for this query.

provider.description: Upstream search provider to use (currently only perplexity).

request_payload.description: Raw provider request payload to persist for audit/replay; if omitted, backend will build it from other inputs.

normalized_query_text.description: Optional pre-normalized query text to store; if omitted, backend will normalize from query.

status.description: Optional initial status to set on the created query record; normally managed by the backend.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching additional results for the same query invocation, if supported.

response_payload.description: Optional raw provider response payload to persist; normally set by the backend after execution.

tool_schemas.name: list_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces visible to the calling identity, with optional filtering by lifecycle status and plan; returns a paginated page of workspace records and refuses invalid filters.

api_key.description: API key presented to authenticate the request (preferred header-equivalent when calling via MCP).

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single workspace by id; returns the workspace record if accessible to the caller and refuses unknown or unauthorized ids.

api_key.description: API key presented to authenticate the request (preferred header-equivalent when calling via MCP).

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new active API key for a workspace and returns the created key metadata plus the one-time plaintext secret; refuses creation for suspended/deleted workspaces or if the caller is not entitled.

api_key.description: API key presented to authenticate the request (must have permission to manage keys in the target workspace).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that will own the API key.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the API key.

tool_schemas.name: revoke_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Revokes an active API key (status -> revoked) so it can no longer create new search queries; returns the updated key metadata and refuses invalid lifecycle transitions.

api_key.description: API key presented to authenticate the request (must have permission to manage keys in the target workspace).

status.description: Set to revoked to revoke the key; any other value is rejected.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored search query records for a workspace with optional filtering by api key, provider, status, and time range; returns a paginated page of query records and refuses invalid filters.

api_key.description: API key presented to authenticate the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose queries to list.

api_key_id.description: Filter by API key id that created the query.

created_after.description: Return only queries created at or after this time (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Return only queries created before this time (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of queries to return in this page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity derived from the presented API key (or anonymous session), including its workspace bindings, granted scopes, and current calendar-month usage versus quota; refuses invalid/expired credentials.

api_key.description: API key presented to authenticate the request; omit to resolve the anonymous session identity if supported.

metadata.name: Perplexity Search
metadata.description: This backend stores authenticated web search requests executed via the Perplexity Search MCP server, along with the normalized results returned from the upstream provider.
